section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a factor structure analysis of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) conducted on a sample of Black women. An exploratory factor analysis initially identified two factors, but closer examination revealed that only one item loaded onto the second factor, supporting a unidimensional structure. A confirmatory factor analysis confirmed this unidimensional model with adequate fit indices (χ2 = 185.02, df = 65, CFI = .94, SRMR = .05, RMSEA = .09), with all factor loadings ranging from .42 to .91.
